notable_absence.finding: The glossary uses its own page-internal 'X — see Y, below/above' pattern four times (N1QL to SQL++, Encryption to Field Level Encryption, Extended Attributes to XATTRs, Transcoders to Custom Transcoders) as an explicit textual redirect rather than a full duplicate entry. This is exactly the shape isSynonymOf is meant for, but each pair's two names resolve to the SAME candidate concept in this extraction (I folded each pair into a single concept under its fuller name - SQL++, Field Level Encryption, XATTRs, Custom Transcoders - rather than minting a second id for the short-form name), so a same-subject-same-object isSynonymOf relation would be a meaningless self-loop and is deliberately omitted rather than forced. The four redirect statements themselves are real page text worth recording here: 'N1QL — see _SQL++_, below.' / 'Encryption — see _Field Level Encryption_, below.' / 'Extended Attributes — see _XATTRs_, below.' / 'Transcoders — See _Custom Transcoders_, above.' A coordinator reconciling with a batch that mints two SEPARATE ids for one of these pairs should use isSynonymOf to link them at that point.

cross_component_finding: This glossary is overwhelmingly a redirect layer, not a source of new facts: of its ~33 entries, the large majority either restate an already-promoted registry concept in plainer words (Collections/Scope to server:collection/server:scope, DCP to protocol:dcp, GSI to index-type:gsi, SQL++ to n1ql:sqlpp, Transactions to server:distributed-acid-transactions, Key-Value Operations and Sub-Document Operations to their already-promoted sdk: ids, the three Services to service:analytics-service/service:eventing-service/service:search-service) or restate a concept minted earlier THIS ROUND at extraction-layer status from a specific howto page (CAS, Cert Auth, Cluster Provisioning/bucket-management, MapReduce Views, Query, Request Tracing). Only a genuinely SDK/client-library-specific handful of terms had no existing equivalent anywhere and needed fresh minting: Custom Transcoders, Diagnostics/Ping/Health Check (the client-side connectivity probes), Observability/Observability Metrics/Orphaned Response Reporting (the three-part telemetry umbrella), Field Level Encryption, XATTRs/Virtual XATTRs, Non-JSON storage, and a capability-level Vector Search concept distinct from the two mechanism-level ones already minted on vector-searching-with-sdk.json. This confirms the round's framing: a glossary page's value in this ontology is almost entirely in resolving reuse-vs-mint decisions and stitching together the page's dense internal cross-reference web (the 'Further Reading' section alone points at four OTHER products' glossaries - server/8.0/learn/glossary, server/8.0/eventing/eventing-Terminologies [already extracted elsewhere in this project], couchbase-lite/android/refer-glossary, and sync-gateway/glossary, none extracted from this batch), not in producing novel technical relations.
cross_product_finding: The glossary's own text handles RBAC/roles and Cert Auth at the coarse, product-model level rather than naming specifics: 'The 3.x API allows some user management programmatically from the SDK' never names a role:* from the 56-member Server catalogue, and Cert Auth is stated to apply to 'Capella and Enterprise Edition only' without further detail - both entries route to the coarsest available registry concepts (rbac-model:role, edition:enterprise) exactly as the round's framing anticipated for a page that could touch almost any namespace but mostly doesn't commit to specifics.
